newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony unit to issue dual 25 bln yen samurai-Merrill.
newsitem.headline: Sony unit to issue dual 25 bln yen samurai-Merrill.

text.p: A U.S. unit of Sony Corp is planning to issue dual-currency samurai bonds for Japanese retail investors in July, Merrill Lynch, which will lead-manage the bonds, said on Monday.
An official at Merrill said the unit, Sony Capital Corp, will be launching about 25 billion yen worth of three-year yen/U.S. dollar dual-currency samurai bonds.
The bonds will be guaranteed by Sony Corp.
It will be the first time that an overseas subsidiary of a Japanese firm has offered samurai bonds.
The subscription will begin on July 7, but the official declined to comment on the specific timing of the launch.
